# WeedIdentification

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A computer vision task that classifies plant species in real-time to distinguish weeds from crops, enabling targeted herbicide application. Demonstrates a practical TCC application where in-network processing of visual data supports precision agriculture, a key vertical for topology-centric edge deployments.
